name: Growth Geeky Image Optimizer
author: Sabbir Ahmed

sections.description:
Growth Geeky Image Optimizer is a powerful, lightweight, and complete image optimization and SEO automation plugin for WordPress.

Save disk space, accelerate page load speeds, improve Google Core Web Vitals (LCP/INP), and achieve image accessibility & SEO compliance automatically.

🌟 Key Features (100% Free & Standalone):

  • Native Image Compression: Lossy, Glossy, & Lossless optimization for JPEG and PNG images via PHP GD or Imagick.
  • Automatic WebP Conversion: Generate lightweight WebP copies of every image upon upload to slash file sizes by up to 80%.
  • Automatic 1-Click Master Backup & Restore: Automatically backs up original uncompressed images to a protected directory. Restore any image back to its original uncompressed state with 1 click at any time.
  • Filename-to-ALT Text Generator: Convert raw image filenames into clean, human-readable ALT text without using external APIs or tokens.
  • Image Inspector & Manual Bulk Spreadsheet Editor: Scan image sizes, dimensions, current ALT tags, filter missing ALT text, search, and edit ALT tags & titles in bulk.
  • Asynchronous Bulk Queue Processor: Process hundreds of images in the background with real-time progress bars.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the growth-geeky-image-optimizer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Growth Geeky Optimizer in your admin menu to configure compression and filename settings.
sections.faq:
Can I restore my original images if needed?

Yes! Growth Geeky Image Optimizer automatically saves original master images to /wp-content/uploads/growthgeeky-backups/ and allows 1-click restore at any time.

Are any external APIs required to use this plugin?

No. All image compression, WebP generation, and Filename-to-ALT text formatting run 100% locally on your WordPress server using standard PHP GD or Imagick libraries.
